== Samples and the source vault ==

The offline Wiki includes a small local demonstration asset and decoder. The repository's own source-file vault is a separate, content-addressed archive of eligible public repository files; it is not a copy of any user-owned cloud backup.

Private Drive links, backup inventories, file identifiers, checksums, restoration recipes, and source-derived passages are intentionally omitted from this public copy. For private recovery, use only the owner's authorized local archive and its private verification records.

The bundled demonstration remains available from [[Image Support Demo]]. Treat imported or archived executable files as inert data; this Wiki does not run them.
